title: Exorcist Reincarnation ～What’s a Fox-Faced, Kansai-Dialect Scumbag Supposed to Do in a Brutal Eroge World?～
description:
The “Reiwa” era—ayakashi and exorcists wage deadly battles across Japan. Kazuramichi Naoshi, the acting head of the prestigious Kazuramichi family of exorcists, realizes he has been reincarnated! To make matters worse, this world where ayakashi run rampant is actually the setting of a modern, hardcore supernatural eroge.

Considering all the insults and verbal abuse he has hurled at his companions up to now, his future as a doomed jobber bound for hell is all but guaranteed!

Fate can be changed! Also for the sake of the beautiful women crying out for help!

Thus begins the lonely, hopeless battle of Kansai’s strongest scumbag—though every now and then, it turns into a full-blown harem paradise.
author: Inashige Nagamaru
